entries.label: Metaverse part of daily life by 2040
entries.quote: By 2040 the metaverse WILL be a much-more-refined and truly fully-immersive, well-functioning aspect of daily life for a half billion or more people globally.
entries.option_b: By 2040 the metaverse WILL NOT be a much-more-refined and truly fully-immersive, well-functioning aspect of daily life for a half billion or more people globally.
entries.subject: metaverse

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
